headline: Break's off the triangle — Wednesday's the window, warm inside
body:
Today is a no. Small-craft advisory across every zone — the Channel through this evening, the outer waters through Wednesday morning. The triangle builds to a WNW gust of 21 by afternoon over 5-ft seas, and Santa Rosa Flats is flat blown out: 7-plus ft with NW 20–30. Sit it out.

Wednesday lays down. The Channel goes E 5–10 backing SW, seas 2–4 ft, and the triangle middle drops to near-calm by afternoon. That's your day to run.

Inside the triangle you're all on the warm side — east corner 71.8, south point 71.2, west corner (south of Santa Cruz) coolest at 70.9. The 64–68 break isn't in the triangle at all; it's slid west to Santa Rosa Flats, sitting 67.6 — the true cool water and the better bet. But the Flats stay 6–9 ft with NW filling back to a gust of 17 late. Worth the ride if your crew can take it. Otherwise start the west edge on the coolest water and follow bait toward it.
